strategic_differentiation: FIELDWISE differentiates itself within the MSCA-PF call scope by connecting biological truth, rigorous transferability testing, sensing-scale integration and operational decision support within a single validation chain, while deliberately designing the resulting digital framework for reuse beyond the development crop. Rather than optimising retrospective predictive accuracy, it tests whether a physiologically grounded water-stress signal—derived from a data-rich, five-season (2022-2026) processing-tomato archive—remains biologically meaningful across unseen years, an independent commercial farmer field, and a change of sensing scale (proximal → UAV/hyperspectral → Sentinel-2). It explicitly refuses four common assumptions (vegetation index = water stress; proximal indices = satellite indices; internal cross-validation = field transferability; one tomato-trained model transferable unchanged to another crop), separating a transferable decision-support core from crop-specific physiological targets and calibration parameters to yield a crop-configurable framework for irrigated high-value horticulture. This is embedded in a distinctive training trajectory that carries a scientific concept through biological definition, leakage-safe modelling, unseen-condition validation, software implementation (DrR web MVP via Krumatic) and industrial evaluation (AgroVIR placement), completing the fellow's progression from plant physiologist/agronomist to an independent Agricultural Data Scientist, and establishing a Hungary-Bulgaria scientific and mobility bridge with a defined post-MSCA replication route.
